title: outbox_tick: delivery lock not released on complete_delivery failure
description: In outbox_worker, after successful HTTP delivery, complete_delivery() is called inside a lock guard. If complete_delivery fails (SQLite error), the lock is held and the outbox row stays locked indefinitely — no retry, no mark_failed. The row becomes a permanent zombie. Fix: ensure the lock is released and failure is recorded regardless of complete_delivery outcome.
